More_players.description: Bigger board for games up to 6 players

Ressource_clusters.description:
Prevent clusters of similar ressources.
For brick and stones (and, for 5-6 players, also desert), prevents two similar tiles from touching.
For wood, wheat and sheep, prevents three similar tiles from touching.

Balanced_ports.description:
Prevent ressourses of touching their
corresponding ports.

Number_clusters.description:
Prevent similar numbers from being next to one another.
Also prevents 6 and 8 to be next to another 6 or 8.

Number_repeats.description:
Prevent numbers from being twice on the same ressource.
Also prevent ressources to have more than one 6 or one 8
(or, for 5-6 players, two 6 or two 8).
